diagnostic: D2_BFF_COMMAND_INPUT: endpoints.sendConductChange.input: command sendConductChange (PersonalConduct.update) asks for expectVersion; each input leaf that fills a stored value names that Entity.path as a field origin.

types.name: ConductAgent
types.description: The agent a personal conduct belongs to: its @name and on whose behalf it acts.

types.name: MyConduct
types.description: The signed-in member's personal conduct with one agent: the agent and how it currently behaves for that member.

types.name: ConductHistoryEntry
types.description: One earlier change the member made to their own conduct with an agent: when, who and a one-line summary.

jsdoc.input: agentId: the agent chosen in the URL.
jsdoc.output: The personal conduct of the signed-in person with that agent: the agent's name and onBehalfOf, and the current conduct summary in plain language.
jsdoc.purpose: Loads the signed-in person's current conduct with the chosen agent, together with the agent's @name and on whose behalf it acts.
jsdoc.processing: Reads the agent from the cm (name, onBehalfOf) and the personal conduct of the logged-in person with that agent from the cm. ownConductOnly: only the conduct of the person signed in is read, never another person's. conductOnlyForAgentActingOnBehalf: if the agent does not act on this person's behalf, the query refuses with a clear error.

jsdoc.input: agentId: the agent chosen in the URL. page and pageSize: the page of history requested.
jsdoc.output: One page of history entries { items, page, pageSize, hasMore }, each with when it happened, who made it and a one-line summary.
jsdoc.purpose: Lists the signed-in person's own earlier changes to their conduct with the chosen agent, newest first, page by page.
jsdoc.processing: Reads from the cm the history of the logged-in person's conduct with that agent, ordered by changedAt descending, and returns the requested page. ownConductOnly: only the history of the person signed in. conductOnlyForAgentActingOnBehalf: refuses for an agent that does not act on this person's behalf. changedBy is returned as the person's readable name, never an id.

jsdoc.input: agentId: the agent whose conduct changes. changeRequest: what the person wrote should change.
jsdoc.output: The personal conduct of the signed-in person with that agent in its new state: the agent's name and onBehalfOf and the updated current conduct summary.
jsdoc.purpose: Sends to the cm, in plain words, what the signed-in person wants to change in how the agent behaves for them.
jsdoc.processing: Sends the change request to the cm as an update of the personal conduct of the logged-in person with that agent; the person is taken from the session, never from the input. ownConductOnly: only the caller's own conduct is updated, no one else's. conductOnlyForAgentActingOnBehalf: refuses when the agent does not act on this person's behalf. Refuses an empty change request. The cm records the change in the person's history.
